title: aleurites moluccanus
intro: Aleurites moluccanus, commonly known as Tung Oil Tree or Chinese Tung, is a plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is a small to medium-sized tree native to China, Taiwan, and other parts of East Asia, valued for its edible seeds and oil extracted from its seeds, which have been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Aleurites moluccanus include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against cardiovascular disease, cancer, and neurodegenerative disorders. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antimicrobial and antifungal properties, and it is also used as a treatment for various skin conditions due to its bioactive constituents, including tung oil, which contains fatty acids like oleic acid and linoleic acid, as well as other bioactive compounds like phytosterols and phenolic compounds.
